Professional Summary 
Shivam Bajaj is a result driven professional with over 4 years in the financial services 
sector. Combining his academic background in Information Technology and Finance, 
he has excelled in roles at Fund Administrators, Investment Banks, and Big 4 firms, 
showcasing expertise in fund accounting and end-to-end operations for Hedge Funds 
and Private Equity. With a distinguished professional background, Shivam has worked 
at SS&C Technologies, BNP Paribas and KPMG. His commitment to excellence, 
coupled with a strong analytical acumen, positions him as a valuable asset for any 
organisation seeking top-tier financial talent.
